context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: なべ/飼う/ちいさな/どら/通行人/お札/車道/絨毯

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、今晩は、本気で、絶対、なべ料理、絶対、ママ、絶対、作るからね
lines.en: Sho, tonight I'm making nabe-pot for real — I promise, seriously.
lines.style: Warm, assured tone. Opens with his name — direct, loving attention. Even pace, gentle but certain. The kind of promise a mother makes when she means it completely.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、犬を、絶対、飼う、絶対、夢を、絶対、見たんだ
lines.en: Mom, I had a dream — I really was keeping a dog, I promise I did.
lines.style: Bright, earnest, eager to share. Rushes slightly on the beginning, then slows to convince her of the dream's realness. Small-boy certainty mixed with need for her to believe him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お庭の、本気で、絶対、ちいさな、絶対、お花、絶対、咲いてきたわよ、翔くん
lines.en: The flowers in the garden have started blooming, Sho — look how small and pretty they are.
lines.style: Gentle observation, invitation to notice. Soft, wondering tone. Slight lift in the middle — she's drawing his attention to something. Warm and present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、おやつに、絶対、どら焼き、絶対、食べたいな、ママ
lines.en: I really want to have dorayaki for snack time, Mom — I really do.
lines.style: Bright, hopeful request. Slight hesitation before naming what he wants — testing the waters. Earnest, not whiny. Ends on a small upward note, asking.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 道で、本気で、絶対、通行人、絶対、ぶつからない、絶対、ように、絶対、気をつけてね、翔くん
lines.en: When you're on the road, Sho, make sure you don't bump into people walking — be careful, okay?
lines.style: Calm, instructive. Matter-of-fact but warm — she's not worried, she's guiding. Slight emphasis on the safety part. Steady, like she's said this before and will again.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんが、本気で、絶対、お札、絶対、ぼくに、絶対、お小遣い、絶対、くれたよ、ママ
lines.en: Grandpa gave me pocket money, Mom — look, real bills!
lines.style: Delighted, animated. Quick pace, eager to share the news and the proof. Pride mixing with excitement — this is important to him. Ends with a small rush of joy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 車道、本気で、絶対、渡る時、絶対、必ず、絶対、左右、絶対、確認してね、翔くん
lines.en: When you cross the road, Sho, you have to look both ways first — left and right — always check. Promise me.
lines.style: Calm, steady, and serious. Repeats the core instruction for emphasis but not alarm. Warm concern underneath. She's teaching something that matters. Ends with a gentle but real need for his agreement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: リビングの、本気で、絶対、新しい、絶対、絨毯、絶対、ふわふわで、絶対、気持ちいいよ、ママ
lines.en: The new carpet in the living room is so soft and fluffy, Mom — it feels so nice!
lines.style: Delighted, sensory-focused. Warm, appreciative tone. He's noticing comfort and sharing it. Quick, bright delivery. The pleasure of a small thing noticed and praised.
